title: A Asset for the Protocol Revisited
author: Ansel Lockridge
blurb: Ansel Ashgrove, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
